scope: Explicitly configured single-user personal worker; not distribution eligibility

dimensions.protocol-lifecycle: framed RuntimeCommand/RuntimeEvent integration and strict native terminal parsing
dimensions.approval-mediation: unattended policy modes; capability false; no implicit approval replay
dimensions.streaming-events: bounded text events, identity and sequence validation
dimensions.usage-accounting: advisory only; native-claude-store cannot assert API billing
dimensions.cancellation: deadline and cancellation supervision with child group teardown
dimensions.canonical-patch: immutable bundle and protected-path validation at worker and runner
dimensions.review-isolation: fresh candidate, private native state, namespace hides host and other histories
dimensions.authentication-profiles: native personal only; no enterprise broker or Codex home
dimensions.workspace-isolation: Sparse filesystem namespace with read-only candidate and explicit writable mounts
dimensions.panic-containment: worker process failure is a failed attempt; no uncertain checkpoint reuse
dimensions.dependency-compatibility: pinned CLI, workspace builds and protocol regressions

licenseCompatibility: unresolved; excluded from local technical qualification
